description: Desert Control AS provides climate-smart agri-tech solutions to combat desertification, soil degradation, and water scarcity in sandy soil regions in Norway, and the United States. It offers liquid natural clay (LNC) technology that enables sustainable ecosystem management by restoring and protecting soil's ability to preserve water and enhance yields for agriculture, forests, and green landscapes. The company provides solutions for agriculture, landscaping, golf courses and turf management, irrigated forests and reforestation, and impact initiatives. Desert Control AS was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Sandnes, Norway.
